entities.summary: Gangan  is a manga imprint owned by Square Enix. It originated as a manga imprint for Enix before the company merged with Square to form Square Enix. It publishes manga in several anthologies aimed at different reader demographic groups in the Japanese market. Its anthologies are home to some popular Square Enix manga series which were adapted into anime series, like Fullmetal Alchemist, Moribito: Guardian of the Spirit, Nabari no Ou, Inu x Boku SS, The Case Study of Vanitas and Soul Eater. The comics are later collected in paperback volumes under brand names such as Gangan Comics , Gangan Comics Joker  and Young Gangan Comics , which identify the anthology of serialisation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Shōnen Gangan's influence on Japanese manga and anime is significant as it has published numerous popular series like Fullmetal Alchemist and Soul Eater, contributing to the global popularity of these genres. Its impact can be seen in the success of Square Enix's anime adaptations.
